regions_list: Arabian Gulf / Middle East (United Arab Emirates)
geographic_coverage_reconciliation.discrepancy_explanation: The original discovery report summary cited '11 geographic regions' by grouping Egypt (Suez) and UAE into a single 'Middle East' region, and grouping UK/Ireland into 'Europe'. When evaluated as distinct maritime operational corridors, there are 12 regional jurisdictions plus 1 international benchmark category (total 13 entries in the coverage matrix table). This minor categorization difference is reconciled and documented.

panama_canal_evidence.document_title: Panama Canal Official Maritime Tariffs & Tolls Schedule; OP Notice to Shipping N-1 and N-7
panama_canal_evidence.fixed_toll_component: Fixed capacity charge scaled by vessel class (Regular <=91 ft beam, Super 91-107 ft, Panamax Plus, Neopanamax >107 ft beam)
panama_canal_evidence.variable_toll_component: Capacity toll per PC/UMS net ton (for bulk carriers/tankers) or per TEU (for container vessels)
panama_canal_evidence.freshwater_surcharge_formula: Fixed base surcharge (1% to 2%) + Variable dynamic surcharge (0% to 10%) determined daily from Gatun Lake water level (range 80.0 ft to 88.5 ft)
panama_canal_evidence.mandatory_transit_assistance: Locomotive wire charges for Panamax locks; tugboat allocation rates for Neopanamax locks; mandatory canal pilotage
panama_canal_evidence.booking_and_reservation: Tiered advance booking fees (Period 1, 2, 3); auction slots for unallocated transit slots
dynamic_inputs_required: Daily Gatun Lake water level (feet) — affects FWS and draft limits
Live transit reservation auction clearing bids (USD) — during drought/congestion
panama_canal_evidence.deterministic_implementation_readiness: PARTIALLY_READY (Static baseline formula, fixed/variable tolls, and FWS formula are deterministic; dynamic slot auction fees cannot be derived from static tariffs)

suez_canal_evidence.document_title: Suez Canal Navigation Circulars, Toll Schedules & Periodical Amendments (Circular No. 1/2024)
suez_canal_evidence.measurement_system: SCNT (Suez Canal Net Tonnage under 1873 Constantinople Convention)
suez_canal_evidence.base_toll_brackets: Progressive SDR rate per SCNT tier (first 5,000 SCNT, next 5,000 SCNT, next 10,000 SCNT, etc.)
suez_canal_evidence.laden_vs_ballast_differentiation: Ballast transits receive ~15% to 20% lower base rates across all tiers
suez_canal_evidence.periodical_surcharges: Published circular percentage surcharges (+5% to +15%) applied on top of SDR base dues by vessel type
suez_canal_evidence.mandatory_transit_assistance: Compulsory escort tugs for laden bulk vessels >100,000 DWT or beam >48m; 4 compulsory transit pilot assignments (Port Said/Suez approaches + convoy)
suez_canal_evidence.ancillary_fees: Mooring boats, projector searchlight rental, harbour master dues
suez_canal_evidence.settlement_currency: SDR (Special Drawing Rights), converted to USD/EUR at National Bank of Egypt daily exchange rate
dynamic_inputs_required: Daily SDR/USD exchange rate from National Bank of Egypt
suez_canal_evidence.deterministic_implementation_readiness: PARTIALLY_READY (SDR base bracket calculation, laden/ballast factors, and escort tug rules are deterministic; final USD settlement requires external daily forex rate)

kiel_canal.issuing_authority: Generaldirektion Wasserstraßen und Schifffahrt (GDWS) / WSV Germany
kiel_canal.measurement_basis: Gross Tonnage (GT) and Traffic Group (Verkehrsgruppe 1 to 6)
kiel_canal.components: Canal Dues (Kanalabgaben) + Pilot Dues (Lotsabgaben) + Pilot Fees (Lotsgelder) + Canal Helmsmen (Steuerleute)
kiel_canal.active_relief: 50% temporary fee reduction under § 8 NOKBefAbgV for vessels with mandatory pilotage

st_lawrence_seaway.document_title: Great Lakes St. Lawrence Seaway Schedule of Tolls
st_lawrence_seaway.issuing_authority: St. Lawrence Seaway Management Corp (SLSMC) / Great Lakes St. Lawrence Seaway Development Corp (GLS)
st_lawrence_seaway.measurement_basis: Gross Registered Tonnage (GRT) + Cargo Metric Tonnes
st_lawrence_seaway.components: Vessel GRT Toll + Commodity Cargo Toll (bulk, grain, steel) across MLO and Welland Canal locks
st_lawrence_seaway.currency: Split CAD (SLSMC locks) and USD (GLS locks)

schema_compatibility_audit.migration_requirement: Adding PC/UMS and SCNT to the Vessel entity will require an additive SQLite schema migration in database.py and models.py
schema_compatibility_audit.currency_conversion_gap: Pelagos has no foreign exchange rate table or forex conversion service. All existing calculators require USD. Non-USD tariffs (EUR, CAD, GBP, JPY, CNY, BRL, ZAR, AED, INR, SDR) cannot be converted to USD without introducing an explicit CurrencyExchangeRate model or reference rate table

material_corrections_to_discovery_report.verified_finding: 12 distinct regional jurisdictions plus 1 international benchmark category (total 13 entries in the coverage matrix table). The original figure counted Middle East as a single region, whereas the matrix distinguishes Egypt (Suez) and UAE (Arabian Gulf).
material_corrections_to_discovery_report.action_taken: Documented in verification report without editing original discovery files.

material_corrections_to_discovery_report.issue: Commercial vs Statutory Separation for Agency Remuneration
material_corrections_to_discovery_report.original_claim: Cost Domain D (Agency) investigated alongside port tariffs
material_corrections_to_discovery_report.verified_finding: Agency remuneration (Normal Agency Fee) is governed strictly by bilateral commercial contracts under FONASBA/BIMCO standards, not port authority regulations.
material_corrections_to_discovery_report.action_taken: Clarified that Domain D must not be modeled as a statutory port tariff; it must be an explicit commercial allowance.

material_corrections_to_discovery_report.issue: SDR Currency Conversion Reality for Suez Canal
material_corrections_to_discovery_report.original_claim: Suez Canal tolls are calculated in SDR
material_corrections_to_discovery_report.verified_finding: While base tolls are calculated in SDR, operational settlement is in USD or EUR. Pelagos currently lacks a forex service, meaning SDR tolls cannot be converted to USD without an explicit exchange rate model.
material_corrections_to_discovery_report.action_taken: Identified as a mandatory architectural prerequisite for Stage F1.4.2.3a.

conditions: 1. Static canal toll formulas for Panama (ACP) and Suez (SCA) can be implemented deterministically using published base brackets, surcharges, and escort rules.
2. An additive database migration must be defined to add pc_ums_net_tonnage and scnt to the Vessel model.

3. Because all 6 seed vessels currently have UNAVAILABLE PC/UMS and SCNT certificates, the initial F1.4.2.3a implementation must fail closed when vessel-specific canal tonnage is missing, or operate under explicit RESEARCH_MODE with clearly disclaimed reference certificates.
4. A minimal, explicit currency exchange rate model (or SDR-to-USD reference rate table) must be introduced to support Suez Canal SDR conversion.
